cart_empty_body: Add products from the catalog, then send the order to your supplier.
price_rule: Prices come from your supplier's price list and are shown on the order once it is saved; they are fixed when the order is approved.
save_failed: The order could not be saved
errors.quantity_invalid: Enter a whole number between 1 and 1,000,000.
errors.meters_invalid: Enter meters above 0, at most two decimals.
errors.too_many: An order can have at most 200 products.
